findings.title: Nearness becomes actionable support
findings.claim: Within the declared pericope, the focus wali relation turns nearness into an actionable support bond: the named Nasara are heard through aid, the reciprocal clause makes support mutual, and the later strengthening image depicts the bond as a body able to bear pressure.
findings.mechanism: The focus places the named communities and awliya in one object relation; the supplied channel evidence connects wali nearness with nṣr aid, while 5:54 supplies an exact strengthening carrier and 5:56 supplies the outcome of a prevailing aligned body.
findings.reader_payoff: The prohibition becomes perceptible as a rule about bringing a support-bearing body into decisive proximity, rather than as a statement about an unqualified feeling of friendliness.
findings.containment: This is bounded to the supplied pericope relation. It does not generalize every social kindness, identify the named communities beyond the packet, or reduce wali to spatial nearness alone.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and every nominated branch lands, but the finding is still an interpretive synthesis of focus and pericope contacts.

findings.title: Guidance acquires a path-shaped boundary
findings.claim: The external plea to be guided along a straight path gives the focus closure a path-shaped contrast: Allah's non-guidance of the wrongdoing people is heard beside a request for direction, while the focus people-class meets the supplied uprightness branch through the same ordered-path contact.
findings.mechanism: The external 1:6 guidance, straight-path, and uprightness occurrences, together with the 1:7 exclusion and straying terms, return through the focus guidance verb and people-class. They add a concrete directional frame beyond the host pericope's general guidance language.
findings.reader_payoff: The final clause can be seen as a boundary on direction: the people classified as wrongdoers are situated in relation to the path from which guidance is requested.
findings.containment: The overlay does not identify the people in 1:7 with the focus group, import a complete Fatiha interpretation, or replace the focus's plain statement about wrongdoing and guidance.

epistemic.reason: The focus and external occurrences supply exact lexical and relational contacts, but the overlay is an authorial inference without a separately trusted review record.
